sections.title: Unblock a user handler
sections.what: Removes a block the signed-in fan placed on another user and returns an empty success response.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond matching the block action.

summary: Lets a signed-in fan remove a block on another user, using the other user's id from the web address.
purpose: Gives fans a way to undo a block they set earlier.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the delete action matching an unblock.
how: 1) Confirms the user is signed in. 2) Reads the blocked user id from the address. 3) Calls the unblock service. 4) Returns an empty success response.
inputs: A DELETE request with the other user's id in the address. The signed-in user comes from the session.
outputs: An empty 204 response when the unblock succeeds.
risks: The id from the address is passed on without a format check here, so the service must reject bad ids.
debug: If unblocking fails, check the unblock function in the moderation service and whether the id in the address is correct.
